segments.text: So welcome everyone, welcome to the Blender Conference 2022.
And we are celebrating that 20 years ago, here in Amsterdam,
Blender became open source. So happy birthday to Blender.
And I want to start the presentation with good news, because I'm still there!
So, this talk is not going to end with a sad ending or whatever. The doctors declared me fully clean. I don't have to worry.
And I'm as healthy as an old man like me can be. So, don't worry. No worries. No worries.
Thank you.
Now, for my story, I do want to take you back three years, because that was the previous Blender conference.
And at the Blender conference, I was making a funny joke,
to say, I'm going to resign from my duties in Blender in five years, right? And that was a little bit challenging fate,
because it wasn't four months later
or I was in hospital, balancing on the edge of life and death.
Luckily, my own prospects quickly went better, but then, you know, it happened. I got out of the hospital and the world was empty.
It was like being in a zombie movie, being the only survival.
So I think people probably remember this famous cartoon.
So we all thought, ah, this whole COVID thing will go away, it's a little thing, right? But it was quite a big thing.
And it was almost three years later, it's still a thing.
Luckily, it's going away, that's why we can do this event.
And I think everybody was like, yeah, finally we can do things again.
Were it not that somebody in the Kremlin decided to invade an innocent country
and play war games with everyone. So that's a big threat. But what's happening after that? We have an energy crisis. All know this, and this is going to be a big thing for the coming years.
And we didn't forget about our good old friend, that climate change. So this is the biggest threat for mankind
that will cause a massive biodiversity collapse.
So, all doom and gloom, right?
But I can tell you, there's even one more thing worse for mankind.
The metaphors, right?
We all know the hype, and on one hand, you could see it as this horrible nightmare, right?
What we know from the Matrix movies, where people will be connected with neural links
directly to the internet, and the big corporations are going to control our bodies and our thoughts
and everything, so that we make sure that we are fully absorbed in some kind of universe that doesn't really exist.
But that's the nightmare version, probably the wet dream of Mark Zuckerberg and other friends, but I hope this is not going to happen.
The other more neutral way to look at it is that this is the new next internet.
The internet will become 3D, or more 3D, and we probably will start browsing
and experiencing the internet with 3D engines.
So that's a great technology challenge. And you can see that the whole industry is jumping on it,
and they are all, of course, promising that they will make it open, open source and open standards. And if you look at all those companies
who are promising to make sure that there will be public standards
that will all be open and friendly and accessible for everyone. So then I think,
so where are the people here, right?
I was last summer at SIGGRAPH in Vancouver, and there were events about the Metaverse,
and you saw those big corporations making big stories about what they are going to do.
And one of the organizers, I met him afterwards, I asked him,
why wasn't Blender invited? Why were we not there?
And he said, oh my God, we forgot probably.
And I said, well, even when you would have invited me,
I would have declared. I don't think I belong there.
Blender is still super small, and I don't think I can make any difference there. All of those companies, the corporations, they're all working with billions of dollars of budgets,
they're developing things and making a pie and slicing it up to make sure that everybody can make a lot of money.
That's not where I can contribute things to. But there is an issue that we have to tackle,
because who do you really trust to make the next Internet?
But is that meta? Is it Google or Amazon? Is it Apple? Or do we trust Elon Musk to do all of this?
